usedFor: Shopify is where products and orders live, and AddToWallet makes Apple Wallet and Google Wallet passes. A “New Product” in Shopify can run “Create Pass” in AddToWallet, giving you a shareable pass link, such as an offer for the launch.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Cancelled” in Shopify, then “Update Pass” in AddToWallet
bestTemplate.why: A cancelled order is a clear moment to change a pass already in someone's wallet. “Update Pass” edits its content, barcode or notifications, so the card stops showing something that no longer applies.

watchOut: “Update Pass” works on an existing pass, so it needs one created earlier by “Create Pass”. “Abandoned Checkout” is polling, so it runs on a schedule.
